high_level_description: The image is a black-and-white photograph of a piece of paper with a poem titled "Stars" by L.E. Bowman. The poem is written in a clear, legible font and occupies the majority of the page. The paper appears to be slightly crumpled or folded at the edges, giving it a worn look. The poem itself is a reflective and somewhat melancholic piece. It speaks about being deeply affected by the world around one, leaving pieces of oneself scattered throughout various places and experiences.
